newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 9.5 pct Jul 11-20 -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 9.5 pct Jul 11-20 -- CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States fell 9.5 percent in the 10 days of July 11-20 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos slumped 10.5 percent, and U.S. sales of imports fell 4.2 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 9.5 percent, to 155,523 from 171,763, CNW said. Domestic truck sales fell 11.5 percent, to 176,282 from 199,161, it said.
Import car sales declined 3.7 percent to 53,199, and import truck sales fell 5.8 percent to 14,136, the report said.
Year-to-date, vehicle sales in the United States reached 8,468,882, off 3.4 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
